title: PROC-1: Operating procedures in force on 2 July 2019

nodes.label: Requirement

props.text: CI tests must pass before a WAF rule change deploys globally. The suite does not measure CPU use.

nodes.quote: The standard procedure for a WAF Managed Rules change indicates that Continuous Integration (CI) tests must pass prior to a global deploy.

nodes.label: Requirement

props.text: Rolling back a WAF rule means running the complete WAF build twice.
props.target: two full builds to roll back

nodes.quote: The rollback plan required running the complete WAF build twice taking too long.

nodes.label: Requirement

props.text: Staff credentials are disabled when the internal control panel is not used frequently.

nodes.quote: some members of the team had lost access because of a security feature that disables their credentials if they don't use the internal control panel frequently

nodes.label: Requirement

props.text: The status page is updated by hand during an incident.

nodes.quote: We didn't update our status page quickly enough.

nodes.label: Requirement

props.text: Customers reach the Dashboard and API through the Cloudflare edge.

nodes.quote: Our customers were unable to access the Cloudflare Dashboard or API because they pass through the Cloudflare edge.
